surface_render_method.description: Controls the blending and the compatibility with certain features

use_transparency_overlap.description: Render multiple transparent layers (may introduce transparency sorting problems)

show_transparent_back.description: Render multiple transparent layers (may introduce transparency sorting problems) (Deprecated: use 'use_tranparency_overlap')

use_backface_culling.description: Use back face culling to hide the back side of faces

use_backface_culling_shadow.description: Use back face culling when casting shadows

use_backface_culling_lightprobe_volume.description: Consider material single sided for light probe volume capture. Additionally helps rejecting probes inside the object to avoid light leaks.

use_transparent_shadow.description: Use transparent shadows for this material if it contains a Transparent BSDF, disabling will render faster but not give accurate shadows

use_raytrace_refraction.description: Use raytracing to determine transmitted color instead of using only light probes. This prevents the surface from contributing to the lighting of surfaces not using this setting.

use_screen_refraction.description: Use raytracing to determine transmitted color instead of using only light probes. This prevents the surface from contributing to the lighting of surfaces not using this setting. Deprecated: use 'use_raytrace_refraction'.

refraction_depth.description: Approximate the thickness of the object to compute two refraction events (0 is disabled) (Deprecated)

thickness_mode.description: Approximation used to model the light interactions inside the object

use_thickness_from_shadow.description: Use the shadow maps from shadow casting lights to refine the thickness defined by the material node tree

name.description: Unique data-block ID name (within a same type and library)

name_full.description: Unique data-block ID name, including library one if any

session_uid.description: A session-wide unique identifier for the data block that remains the same across renames and internal reallocations, unchanged when reloading the file

is_evaluated.description: Whether this ID is runtime-only, evaluated data-block, or actual data from .blend file

original.description: Actual data-block from .blend file (Main database) that generated that evaluated one

users.description: Number of times this data-block is referenced

use_fake_user.description: Save this data-block even if it has no users

use_extra_user.description: Indicates whether an extra user is set or not (mainly for internal/debug usages)

is_embedded_data.description: This data-block is not an independent one, but is actually a sub-data of another ID (typical example: root node trees or master collections)

is_linked_packed.description: This data-block is linked and packed into the .blend file

is_missing.description: This data-block is a place-holder for missing linked data (i.e. it is [an override of] a linked data that could not be found anymore)

is_runtime_data.description: This data-block is runtime data, i.e. it won't be saved in .blend file. Note that e.g. evaluated IDs are always runtime, so this value is only editable for data-blocks in Main data-base.

is_editable.description: This data-block is editable in the user interface. Linked data-blocks are not editable, except if they were loaded as editable assets.

tag.description: Tools can use this to tag data for their own purposes (initial state is undefined)

is_library_indirect.description: Is this ID block linked indirectly

library.description: Library file the data-block is linked from

library_weak_reference.description: Weak reference to a data-block in another library .blend file (used to re-use already appended data instead of appending new copies)

asset_data.description: Additional data for an asset data-block

preview.description: Preview image and icon of this data-block (always None if not supported for this type of data)

clip_start.description: Probe clip start, below which objects will not appear in reflections

show_clip.description: Show the clipping distances in the 3D view

show_influence.description: Show the influence volume in the 3D view

visibility_bleed_bias.description: Bias for reducing light-bleed on variance shadow maps (Deprecated)

visibility_blur.description: Filter size of the visibility blur (Deprecated)

visibility_collection.description: Restrict objects visible for this probe (Deprecated)

use_data_display.description: Display sampled data in the viewport to debug captured light

data_display_size.description: Viewport display size of the sampled data

falloff.description: Control how fast the probe influence decreases

clip_end.description: Probe clip end, beyond which objects will not appear in reflections

use_custom_parallax.description: Enable custom settings for the parallax correction volume

show_parallax.description: Show the parallax correction volume in the 3D view

parallax_distance.description: Lowest corner of the parallax bounding box

resolution_scale.description: Determines the number of rays per pixel. Higher resolution uses more memory.

use_backface_hit.description: Consider rays hitting backfaces as valid

backface_radiance_scale.description: Amount of the front face lighting to reuse for backface lighting approximation

use_denoise.description: Enable noise reduction techniques for raytraced effects

denoise_temporal.description: Accumulate samples by reprojecting last tracing results

denoise_bilateral.description: Blur the resolved radiance using a bilateral filter

screen_trace_thickness.description: Surface thickness used to detect intersection when using screen-tracing

trace_max_roughness.description: Maximum roughness to use the tracing pipeline for. Higher roughness surfaces will use fast GI approximation. A value of 1 will disable fast GI approximation.

screen_trace_quality.description: Precision of the screen space ray-tracing
